name: ceramics-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: All catalog browsing/search, cart, checkout, and order-history/lookup calls.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Optional customer sign-in/sign-up (OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE) enabling saved addresses and order history; checkout also works as a guest without this.

description: The customer-facing storefront SPA: catalog browsing/search/filter, product detail with variant selection and stock display, cart management, guest and signed-in checkout with Stripe card payment, saved addresses and order history for signed-in customers, and guest order lookup by reference + email. Does NOT provide any admin/back-office catalog-management screens.
